generated_plan.goal: Become an NLP Engineer in 5 months for the Bangladesh market with a fast job target.

prerequisites.projects_experience: Built small academic and personal projects

learning_plan.theme: Foundational NLP & Traditional ML for Text
topics: Python for Data Science refresher (NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn basics for text)
Core NLP Libraries: NLTK and SpaCy for text preprocessing
Text Preprocessing: Tokenization, Stemming, Lemmatization, Stop Words Removal
Feature Engineering: Bag-of-Words, TF-IDF, Count Vectorizer
Traditional Machine Learning for Text Classification: Naive Bayes, SVM, Logistic Regression (Scikit-learn)
Introduction to Word Embeddings: Conceptual understanding of Word2Vec (Gensim for usage)
learning_plan.project_idea: Build a simple sentiment analysis model using TF-IDF and Logistic Regression on a dataset (e.g., movie reviews).

learning_plan.theme: Deep Learning for NLP - Sequence Models
topics: Deep Dive into Word Embeddings: Pre-trained embeddings (GloVe, FastText), using embedding layers in DL models
Introduction to Neural Networks for NLP: Feedforward NNs, Embedding layers
Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs): Architecture, vanishing gradients
Advanced RNNs: LSTMs and GRUs for sequence modeling
Implementing LSTMs/GRUs for Text Classification (TensorFlow/PyTorch)
Padding, masking, and handling variable-length sequences
learning_plan.project_idea: Develop a text classifier (e.g., spam detection, fake news) using an LSTM or GRU network with pre-trained word embeddings (e.g., GloVe) in TensorFlow or PyTorch.

topics: Attention Mechanism: Intuition and application in sequence models
Introduction to Transformer Architecture: Encoder-Decoder concept (high-level)
Pre-trained Transformers: BERT and its variants (RoBERTa, DistilBERT) - focus on usage
Hugging Face Transformers Library: Installation, pipeline, loading pre-trained models and tokenizers
Fine-tuning Pre-trained Models: Text Classification, Named Entity Recognition (NER) using Hugging Face
Transfer Learning in NLP
learning_plan.project_idea: Fine-tune a pre-trained BERT model (using Hugging Face Transformers) for a specific NLP task like Named Entity Recognition on a custom dataset or multi-class text classification.

topics: **Bangla NLP Introduction**: Challenges (e.g., rich morphology), basic processing (tokenization, stemming for Bangla)
Exploring Bangla NLP resources/libraries (e.g., 'bnlp', 'banglanlp' or relevant academic papers/datasets)
Common NLP Applications: Chatbots (intent recognition, basic entity extraction), Information Retrieval (basic search concepts)
Model Deployment Basics: Packaging an NLP model as a simple REST API using Flask/FastAPI (for inference)
Understanding performance metrics beyond accuracy (Precision, Recall, F1-score for imbalanced datasets)
learning_plan.project_idea: Build a basic Bangla sentiment analysis tool or an intent classification model for a simple Bangla chatbot, and expose it via a REST API.

topics: **Consolidate Portfolio Project**: Select one or two best projects, refine them (code quality, documentation, demo), and make them accessible (GitHub, potentially a simple web demo).
In-depth review of core NLP concepts, algorithms, and architectures.
Interview Preparation: Common NLP interview questions (theory, project discussion), Python coding challenges (data structures, algorithms relevant to text processing).
Resume/CV building: Tailor for NLP Engineer roles, highlight projects and skills.
Networking: LinkedIn profile optimization, connecting with NLP professionals in Bangladesh.
learning_plan.project_idea: Enhance your best project (from previous months or a new idea) into a polished, production-ready demonstration. Focus on clear problem statement, elegant solution, and presentation.

learning_strategy.daily_breakdown: Allocate 20-30 minutes for theoretical learning (articles, tutorials) and 30-40 minutes for hands-on coding and experimentation.
learning_strategy.weekend_flexibility: Consider dedicating slightly more time on weekends for deeper dives into projects or catching up, if possible.
learning_strategy.focus_on_projects: Given the 'fast job' goal, practical project implementation and a strong portfolio are paramount. Always try to implement what you learn.
learning_strategy.leverage_existing_knowledge: Since you're familiar with Python, TensorFlow, and PyTorch, focus on applying these to NLP-specific problems immediately.
learning_strategy.community_engagement: Join online NLP communities, follow key researchers/practitioners, and participate in discussions to stay updated and get help.
